Jump Style.tooltip: Charge: you have to hold space to charge a jump and release space to perform the jump. Instant: you will jump immediately upon pressing space.

Enable Midair Turning.tooltip: Allows you to change direction and/or slow down in midair, even without your jetpack.

Sprint Button.tooltip: Whether sprinting is activated by holding the Up Thrust button (usually Shift) or the Down Thrust button (usually Ctrl).

SprintMultiplier.title: Sprint Speed Multiplier
SprintMultiplier.tooltip: How much your speed is multiplied while sprinting. Default: 1.75

Start Sprinting On Landing.tooltip: If you're holding the sprint button and a directional input when you land on the ground, you will stop thrusting and start sprinting.

Show Thruster Effect while Sprinting.tooltip: Makes your jetpack thrusters fire as you sprint, as if they're boosting you. No gameplay effect.

Speed Up Ghosts while Sprinting.tooltip: Makes ghosts move faster while you're sprinting.

Enable Emergency Boost.tooltip: Allows you to shoot up into the air by pressing space twice.

Emergency Boost Power.tooltip: How powerful an emergency boost is. Default: 15

Emergency Boost Cost.tooltip: The amount of fuel an emergency boost uses. Default: 30

Emergency Boost Volume.tooltip: How loud the emergency boost sound is compared to the default volume. Default: 1

Emergency Boost Input Time.tooltip: The maximum amount of time in seconds between jump inputs that will trigger an emergency boost. Default: 0.25

Emergency Boost Camera Shake Amount.tooltip: How much the camera shakes when doing an emergency boost. Only works if Camera Shake mod is installed and enabled. Default: 1

Enable Floaty Physics.tooltip: Lowers your acceleration in low gravity, making movement floatier.

Floaty Physics Power.tooltip: The higher this number is, the faster you'll notice your acceleration decreasing as gravity decreases. Default: 1

Floaty Physics Minimum Acceleration.tooltip: The minimum acceleration that can take effect with floaty physics. Default: 0.25

Floaty Physics Minimum Gravity.tooltip: The gravity below which floaty physics will start to take effect. Default: 1

Minimum Gravity.tooltip: The gravity at which the minimum acceleration will take effect. Default: 0.5

Enable Wall Jumping.tooltip: Allows you to climb up walls by jumping off of them.

Maximum Number of Wall Jumps.tooltip: The number of times you can Wall Jump without touching the ground. Default: 5

Normal Speed.tooltip: How quickly you move normally. Vanilla: 6

Strafe Speed.tooltip: How quickly you move when walking backwards or to the side. Vanilla: 4

Walk Speed.tooltip: How quickly you move when holding the walk (roll mode) button. Vanilla: 3

Focused Lantern Speed.tooltip: How quickly you move while focusing a lantern. Vanilla: 2

Ground Acceleration.tooltip: How quickly you reach your maximum speed. Vanilla: 0.5

Minimum Jump Power.tooltip: The power of your jump when it isn't charged. Vanilla: 3

Maximum Jump Power.tooltip: The power of your jump when it is fully charged. Vanilla: 7

Air Speed.tooltip: How quickly you can move in midair. Vanilla: 3

Air Acceleration.tooltip: How quickly you reach your maximum speed while in midair. Vanilla: 0.09

Jetpack Acceleration.tooltip: How powerful your jetpack is. Vanilla: 6

Jetpack Boost Acceleration.tooltip: How powerful your jetpack is while boosting. Vanilla: 23

Max Jetpack Boost Time.tooltip: How long you can use your jetpack boost, in seconds. Vanilla: 1

Max Jetpack Fuel Amount.tooltip: The amount of fuel your jetpack can hold at full capacity. Vanilla: 100
